datasets.title: IGAD Region - Dekadal Combined Drought Indicator (CDI) 2024
datasets.description: Dekadal (10 days) Combined Drought Indicator (CDI) as implemented in the East Africa Drought Watch, and which is used for detecting and monitoring areas that either are affected or have the potential to be affected by meteorological, agricultural and/or hydrological drought.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/igad-region-dekadal-combined-drought-indicator-cdi-2024]

contact_point.name: IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Center (ICPAC)

creator.name: IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Center (ICPAC)

lineage.description: The Combined Drought Indicator (CDI) is generated through integration of multiple drought indices (meteorological, agricultural, and hydrological components) implemented by ICPAC's East Africa Drought Watch system. Dekadal (10-day) raster outputs are produced to detect and monitor areas affected by or at risk of drought across the IGAD region.

sources.name: IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Center (ICPAC)
sources.description: East Africa Drought Watch Combined Drought Indicator (CDI) model that integrates meteorological, agricultural, and hydrological drought indicators into a unified dekadal monitoring product for drought detection and early warning.
